summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K to announce the effective implementation of a 1-for-50 reverse share consolidation, approved at an EGM on 29 May 2026. Shares trade under temporary ticker ATHDA on a deferred-settlement basis through 11 June; normal trading resumes 12 June under ticker ATH. Options also receive temporary codes. Fractional entitlements are rounded up to the nearest whole share. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation event. The filing serves only to notify the market of the effective date and trading mechanics. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The event is purely administrative.
